This tab shows an interactive scatterplot of the data.

* Each point represents an individual observation of Survival Rate (as a percent) against Thiamine Concentration (in nmol/g).
* Curves and shaded areas show fitted models and their uncertainty. There is one model for each species.
* Points and curves are colored based on species.
* The plot is interactive. Click and drag to zoom into the plot. Hover over points to see more information about that observation.
* The toolbar above the plot lets you zoom or pan the plot, reset the view, and export the plot as an image.

You can also add your own data to the scatterplot:

* Select a Species for your data point.
* Enter a Thiamine Concentration (required) and an Observed Survival Rate (optional).
* If you enter an Observed Survival Rate, it will be shown as a solid, black point on the plot.
* The app will also calculate a predicted Survival Rate using the selected Species’ model. The predicted value is shown on the plot as a dotted circle, black point.
* When you add data, a summary table appears below the plot.

You can export this table to a CSV file by clicking the "Export table to CSV" button.
The sidebar filters also affect this tab.

For example, selecting a Species will only show points and curves of that species.
